rules.statement: For a cause of action to arise on a loan of money without any prior agreement as to the date of repayment, it must be after the lender has made demand and the debtor fails to repay within the specified time.
rules.supporting_quote: "The cause of action to sue for the recovery of a loan given without any agreement as to the time of repayment does not arise until the lender has asked the borrower for the return of the money and he fails to repay the money within the time specified in the lender's demand."
